title: SOC 2 Type II controls audit
description: Implement and document all required SOC 2 Type II controls. Required by enterprise procurement teams before any contract can be signed. Blocks security review at Acme Corp, Meridian Health, and NorthStar Capital.

title: Agent Hub catalog foundation
description: Core infrastructure for the Agent Hub: catalog schema, publish/install APIs, versioning backend. Nothing in the Hub works without this. Gateway to the growth flywheel.

title: SSO / SAML integration
description: Enterprise customers require SSO/SAML before procurement sign-off. Acme Corp and Meridian Health have both flagged this as a hard blocker. No SSO = no PO.

title: Multi-org workspace isolation
description: Strict data isolation between organizations. Required for any multi-tenant enterprise deployment. Meridian Health's legal team will not approve without this.

title: Audit log export API
description: Exportable, immutable audit logs via API. SOC 2 evidence collection depends on this. Also a hard requirement for NorthStar Capital's compliance team.

title: Agent versioning and rollback
description: Version control for published agents — save, promote, roll back. Without this, shipping a broken agent to the Hub catalog has no recovery path. Prerequisite for a safe Hub GA.

title: Webhook trigger system
description: Event-driven agent execution via webhooks (GitHub push, PR open, etc.). Unlocks async workflows and is a top requested feature by developer beta users.

title: Per-workspace cost tracking
description: Track model usage and cost per workspace, user, and agent. Required for enterprise billing and for NorthStar Capital's FinOps team to approve the contract.

title: Model-neutral routing layer
description: Route agent runs to any model (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OSS) via a single API. Core to the 'neutral control plane' positioning. No vendor lock-in = enterprise trust.

title: SCIM user provisioning
description: Automated user provisioning and deprovisioning via SCIM. Required by Acme Corp's IT team for their 2,000-seat rollout. Without SCIM, manual onboarding kills the deal.

title: Agent forking in catalog
description: Let users fork a published agent, customize it, and re-publish. Core to the 'GitHub for agents' network effect — this is how the flywheel starts spinning.

title: Rate limiting and quota enforcement
description: Per-workspace rate limits and usage quotas. Required to prevent runaway costs and to support tiered pricing. Unblocks the enterprise billing model.

title: Slack trigger integration
description: Trigger agents from Slack messages and commands. Most-requested integration from growth beta users. Low effort, high activation — drives word-of-mouth.

title: Public Agent Hub GA launch
description: General availability launch of the public Agent Hub catalog. The flagship growth moment — press, Product Hunt, developer community. Cannot ship without versioning, forking, and the catalog foundation stable.

title: Enterprise SLA and uptime dashboard
description: 99.9% SLA commitment with a real-time uptime dashboard for enterprise customers. NorthStar Capital and Meridian Health both require contractual SLA guarantees before signing.
